newsitem.title: CHINA: French President Chirac arrives for China visit.
newsitem.headline: French President Chirac arrives for China visit.

text.p: French President Jaques Chirac arrived in Beijing on Thursday for a four-day visit expected to see the signing of hundreds of millions of dollars worth of business deals and to set the seal on strong political ties.
Chirac received a red carpet welcome at Beijing's Capital Airport where he was greeted by Wang Zhongyu, chairman of the State Economic and Trade Commission.

Chirac was accompanied by some 60 heads of major French enterprises. He will meet his Chinese counterpart Jiang Zemin in Beijing and oversee the signing of hundreds of millions of dollars worth of business deals for French industry.
He was also due to visit Shanghai, China's booming commercial hub, to open an exhibition on French technology, before leaving on Sunday.
